ns0:media.alt: This figure has the graph of a straight dashed line on the x y-coordinate plane. The x and y axes run from negative 10 to 10. A straight dashed line is drawn through the points (0, 3), (4, 2), and (8, 1). The line divides the x y-coordinate plane into two halves. The bottom left half is shaded red to indicate that this is where the solutions of the inequality are.
